subject: Re: errors in CV calculation for v6.0 ?

messages.subject: Re: errors in CV calculation for v6.0 ?
parts:
Hi Sarahlee (+ list), Yes, there is a problem with the default variance
estimator for point transect surveys (line transects are fine). It's documented
here:
http://www.ruwpa.st-and.ac.uk/distance/bugzilla/show_bug.cgi?id=92
We aim to correct it in a version to be released very soon. - Len


On 22/06/2011 20:53, S. Horning wrote:
> > I was told that there was an error in the way Distance 6.0 calculated CV for density estimates, could anyone tell me if this is indeed the case and if so if the error will be corrected in future versions. Thank you.
